schema_contract.canonical_serialization: UTF-8 JSON sorted keys compact separators trailing LF non-finite prohibited
schema_contract.identity_rule: SHA-256 of canonical section excluding its identity field

authoritative_trade_atoms.price_and_net_pnl: V002 binary64 lifecycle result serialized to exactly 6 decimal USD places then parsed as signed integer microdollars
authoritative_trade_atoms.net_R: V002 net_R serialized to exactly 12 decimal places then parsed as a reduced rational
authoritative_trade_atoms.quantity: non-negative whole shares; fractional shares prohibited
authoritative_trade_atoms.timestamp: timezone-aware instant normalized to integer Unix nanoseconds
authoritative_trade_atoms.commission: exact rational microdollars until V002 6-decimal serialization boundary

precision_policy.scoring_arithmetic: integers and reduced rational arithmetic only; binary floating point prohibited after canonical trade atoms
precision_policy.rounding_mode: round-half-even only at the inherited V002 6-decimal USD and 12-decimal R serialization boundaries; no later intermediate rounding
precision_policy.decimal_display: 12-place round-half-even display only and never authoritative for order, score, or identity
precision_policy.signed_zero: canonicalize every exact zero to numerator 0 denominator 1 and serialize without a negative sign
precision_policy.comparison_tolerance: zero; compare exact integers, exact rationals, or the frozen algebraic downside comparator
precision_policy.hash_representation: signed integer numerators and strictly positive integer denominators in canonical JSON

lifecycle_outcome_semantics.entry: signal timestamp equals exact next regular one-minute bar open; missing, halted, expired, nonpositive, or invalidated entry is rejected without delay or fabricated fill
lifecycle_outcome_semantics.entry_fill: V002 raw next-bar open with frozen adverse entry friction; only one atomic whole-share fill is supported; partial fills are unsupported
lifecycle_outcome_semantics.same_bar: after the bar-open gap checks, stop is evaluated before target whenever both are reachable in the same completed bar
lifecycle_outcome_semantics.gap_exit: open through stop exits at min(open,stop); open through target exits at max(open,target); stop precedence remains conservative
lifecycle_outcome_semantics.timeout: exit at close of the Nth complete holding bar beginning with the entry bar, or the frozen session liquidation bar, whichever occurs first
lifecycle_outcome_semantics.missing_minutes: a non-halt missing required open-position minute is an integrity failure and aborts the entrant run; no synthetic bar or exit
lifecycle_outcome_semantics.halts: no entry during a halt; an open position remains unmarked and applies stop, target, then timeout at the first executable post-resume open
lifecycle_outcome_semantics.corporate_actions: use only V002 point-in-time normalized execution records; unknown, conflicting, intraday-effective, or broken lineage aborts the affected entrant run
lifecycle_outcome_semantics.duplicates: one proposal identity may be evaluated once; duplicate identity is an entrant integrity failure; distinct proposals use frozen timestamp, strategy identity, symbol ordering
lifecycle_outcome_semantics.short_pnl: quantity*(cost_adjusted_entry-cost_adjusted_exit)-entry_commission-exit_commission; scored short trades remain prohibited without borrow and fee evidence
lifecycle_outcome_semantics.invalid_prices: zero, negative, non-finite, unavailable, or untradeable required prices reject before fill or abort after fill according to the disqualification matrix
lifecycle_outcome_semantics.prices: corporate-action-adjusted prices are authoritative; raw unadjusted prices never enter scoring

portfolio_capital_semantics.isolation: each entrant receives an independent 100000 USD initial ledger and cannot consume or alter another entrant's cash, capacity, loss state, inputs, or outcomes

rankings.equal_risk: every otherwise accepted trade uses frozen 250 USD risk before capacity constraints
rankings.capital_constrained: the same entrant's proposals share its own cash, three-position limit, 50-percent gross exposure limit, and daily lockout

portfolio_capital_semantics.reservation: reserve cost-adjusted entry notional plus entry commission atomically at fill
portfolio_capital_semantics.release: release exit proceeds net of exit commission only at the completed exit timestamp; released cash may fund later proposals
portfolio_capital_semantics.proposal_order: signal timestamp ascending, immutable strategy identity UTF-8 ascending, symbol UTF-8 ascending, proposal identity UTF-8 ascending
portfolio_capital_semantics.same_timestamp: apply exits first, then daily-lockout state, then entries in proposal order
portfolio_capital_semantics.concurrency: maximum three open positions per entrant
portfolio_capital_semantics.gross_exposure: sum absolute cost-adjusted entry notionals of open positions; long and short exposure never net
portfolio_capital_semantics.duplicate_security: a second position in the same security while one is open is rejected as concurrency_conflict_same_security
portfolio_capital_semantics.daily_lockout: stop new entries when realized net P&L plus marked P&L at the latest complete bar is at or below -1 percent of initial capital; existing positions continue
portfolio_capital_semantics.cash: exact microdollars; negative cash and theoretical leverage are prohibited
portfolio_capital_semantics.sizing: floor 250 USD divided by cost-adjusted-entry minus rounded stop, then cap by available cash and 50-percent gross exposure; whole shares only
portfolio_capital_semantics.unused_capital: does not enter any raw event except through absence of filled positions; capital efficiency counts deployed capital-time only
portfolio_capital_semantics.rejected_proposals: record reason but consume no cash, capital-time, trade count, or P&L

capital_efficiency_semantics.purpose: net discovery economic result per unit of the entrant's own gross deployed entry capital occupied through time
capital_efficiency_semantics.numerator: sum canonical completed-trade net P&L microdollars for the entrant in the authorized discovery cohort
capital_efficiency_semantics.position_notional: absolute actual filled whole-share quantity times canonical cost-adjusted entry price in microdollars; commissions, marks, exits, unrealized P&L, and other entrants are excluded
capital_efficiency_semantics.denominator: exact sum of position capital-time across accepted, filled, valid, completed discovery positions
capital_efficiency_semantics.unit: inverse nanoseconds after the common microdollar unit cancels
capital_efficiency_semantics.formula: capital_efficiency = total_net_pnl_microdollars / capital_time_microdollar_nanoseconds reduced by gcd
capital_efficiency_semantics.concurrency: overlapping position capital-time is additive; long and short absolute notionals never net
capital_efficiency_semantics.reuse: sequential positions contribute separate intervals; released capital may be reused and is counted again only while redeployed
capital_efficiency_semantics.partial_fills: unsupported by V002; V004 introduces no tranche or partial-fill behavior
capital_efficiency_semantics.partial_intervals: exact nanoseconds are used without session or bar rounding
capital_efficiency_semantics.rejected_and_unfilled: excluded from numerator, denominator, and completed-trade population
capital_efficiency_semantics.zero_denominator: event-ineligible with V004_CAPITAL_EFFICIENCY_ZERO_DEPLOYED_TIME and existing zero event-score treatment; no raw zero or infinity
capital_efficiency_semantics.negative_and_zero_pnl: negative numerator is eligible when denominator is positive; zero numerator canonicalizes to 0/1
capital_efficiency_semantics.ranking: higher is better through unchanged V003 ordinal percentile scoring

cost_stress_semantics.components: multiply V002 combined 10-basis-point adverse market friction, per-share commission, minimum commission, and any evidenced borrow fee by the scenario multiplier; price impact remains unsupported and zero
cost_stress_semantics.proposals: reuse immutable baseline proposals, signal timestamps, raw entry opens, raw exit prices, stops, targets, and exit timestamps; regeneration and eligibility reevaluation are prohibited
cost_stress_semantics.sizing: reuse baseline actual filled quantity and portfolio acceptance; do not resize, reallocate, or rerun daily/concurrency/exposure gates
cost_stress_semantics.entry_exit: reprice the same raw entry and raw exit with stressed adverse friction; stops and targets remain frozen absolute prices and no exit may move to another bar
cost_stress_semantics.infeasible: if stressed cost-adjusted entry is at or above the frozen target, or any required stressed fill is nonpositive/unavailable, the event is ineligible with V004_COST_STRESS_INFEASIBLE_FILL
cost_stress_semantics.borrow: a scored short requires point-in-time borrow and fee evidence at baseline; absent evidence disqualifies it before stress; evidenced borrow fee is multiplied
cost_stress_semantics.scenario_expectancy: mean exact stressed net_R across the same baseline completed-trade population
cost_stress_semantics.zero_trades: event-ineligible with existing zero event-score treatment
cost_stress_semantics.baseline_disqualification: entrant remains disqualified and is not stress-ranked
cost_stress_semantics.stress_only_failure: event-ineligible with zero event score; not an entrant disqualification unless caused by integrity corruption
cost_stress_semantics.tie: higher exact 2x-cost expectancy, then immutable identity under unchanged V003

common_rules.eligible_population: registered V002 benchmark entrants that are not disqualified and have all event-required valid inputs
common_rules.invalid_event: exclude from V003 event denominator and assign existing exact 0/1 event score with a deterministic reason
common_rules.ordering: UTC exit timestamp; trades sharing an exit timestamp are aggregated before path metrics; remaining records sort by entry timestamp, symbol UTF-8, proposal identity UTF-8
common_rules.weighting: each completed trade contributes equally unless an event explicitly groups by month, regime, split, or capital-time
common_rules.non_finite: event-ineligible; integrity-origin non-finite values abort or disqualify under the matrix
common_rules.rounding: precision policy applies; no event-specific hidden tolerance
common_rules.tie_behavior: unchanged V003 event tie fields followed by immutable strategy identity

events.name: Net expectancy
events.timestamp_semantics: completed exits in the opened stage

events.name: Downside-adjusted return
events.purpose: mean return relative to lower partial second moment
events.domain: finite real when downside second moment positive
events.timestamp_semantics: completed exits in the opened stage
events.population: all valid completed trades with at least one negative net_R
events.final_rounding: store exact mu and q; decimal display non-authoritative

events.name: Maximum drawdown
events.timestamp_semantics: UTC exit instants; same-instant results aggregated
events.formula: max_t(prior_peak_cumulative_R-cumulative_R_t), with initial cumulative_R and peak both 0

events.name: Profit factor
events.purpose: gross winning P&L per gross losing P&L
events.population: all valid completed trades with at least one win and one loss
events.winsorization: event score naturally bounded by V003; raw metric not clipped

events.name: Payoff ratio
events.purpose: average win per absolute average loss
events.population: winning and losing valid completed trades

events.name: Hit rate
events.purpose: fraction of completed trades with strictly positive net P&L
events.population: all valid completed trades; zero P&L is not a win

events.name: Tail-loss control
events.purpose: negative average of the worst five-percent trade outcomes
events.formula: k=ceil(n/20); sort net_R ascending; raw=-sum(first k)/k
events.aggregation_order: net_R ascending then proposal identity for equal values

events.name: Monthly stability
events.purpose: typical monthly expectancy penalized by dispersion
events.timestamp_semantics: America/New_York calendar month of exit timestamp
events.population: active months with at least five valid completed trades
events.formula: median(month_expectancy)-median(abs(month_expectancy-median(month_expectancy))); even median is arithmetic mean of two central exact values
events.disqualification: requires at least three qualifying months
events.aggregation_order: month YYYY-MM ascending; median value ordering exact

events.name: Regime stability
events.purpose: worst expectancy across prospectively frozen regimes
events.timestamp_semantics: label fixed for session before its regular open and bound by manifest
events.population: regimes with at least ten valid completed trades
events.disqualification: overlapping, outcome-derived, changed, or post-open labels abort tournament
events.aggregation_order: regime label UTF-8 ascending before exact minimum
events.stage_availability: discovery only after a separately frozen pre-outcome regime manifest with at least two qualifying regimes

events.name: Validation consistency
events.timestamp_semantics: validation used only after formally opened and completed
events.population: unchanged entrants qualifying in discovery and untouched validation

events.name: One-time holdout consistency
events.timestamp_semantics: holdout used only after one-time authorized opening and completion
events.population: unchanged entrants qualifying in all three stages
events.disqualification: identity, repeated holdout, or stage contamination disqualifies

events.name: Capital efficiency
events.domain: all exact rationals with positive denominator
events.population: accepted, filled, valid, completed discovery positions attributed to entrant

events.name: Trade sufficiency
events.missing: zero count produces raw 0 but remains event-ineligible under V001 zero-trade rule

events.name: Execution robustness
events.purpose: worst expectancy under frozen transaction-cost stresses
events.timestamp_semantics: same baseline entry and exit instants in every scenario
events.population: same baseline valid completed-trade population in all three scenarios
events.stage_availability: opened stage with reconciled baseline outcomes

events.name: Parameter sensitivity robustness
events.population: canonical contract and every prospectively declared variant
events.formula: minimum(all declared expectancy values); canonical-only contracts use canonical expectancy and range 0
events.aggregation_order: canonical first then variant identity UTF-8 ascending
events.stage_availability: opened stage; current V002 variants empty

event-ineligible; never rank infinity or NaN

disqualification_matrix.placement: disqualified entrants are listed after all nondisqualified entrants with no event ranks, no medals, zero advancement credit, and reason codes sorted UTF-8; identity orders multiple disqualified entrants
disqualification_matrix.integrity_rule: integrity violations never become ordinary low scores
